title: The Demon Within
summary: Attacked by the savage Lesser Imp, Ha-Jun suffers excruciating biological reconstruction as his Demon Sovereign bloodline overrides his human frailty. Driven by ancient instinct, he unleashes the demonic gauntlet to annihilate the beast—awakening Kuro's telepathic consciousness.

panels.action: The 8-foot tall Lesser Imp launches forward in a ferocious sprint, clawed feet ripping chunks out of the rain-slicked concrete floor.
panels.prose_en: The 8-foot tall Lesser Imp launches forward in a ferocious sprint, clawed feet ripping chunks out of the rain-slicked concrete floor.
panels.prose_hi: 8 foot lamba lesar imp ek krur sprint mein aage badhta hai, uske panje baarish se gire concrete ke farsh ke tukdon ko cheerte hue nikalte han.

panels.action: The beast's massive serrated blade-arm sweeps horizontally downward in a lethal arc aimed directly at Ha-Jun's neck.
panels.prose_en: The beast's massive serrated blade-arm sweeps horizontally downward in a lethal arc aimed directly at Ha-Jun's neck.
panels.prose_hi: Janvar ki vishal daatedar bled-bangh ek ghatak chaap mein kshaitij roop se neeche ki or ghumti hai jiska lakshya sidhe Ha-Jun ki gardan par hota hai.

panels.action: In hyper-slow motion, Ha-Jun sees the blade coming and throws himself sideways into a desperate evasive dive.
panels.prose_en: In hyper-slow motion, Ha-Jun sees the blade coming and throws himself sideways into a desperate evasive dive.
panels.prose_hi: Ati-dhimi gati men, Ha-Jun blade ko aate hue dekhta hai aur khud ko bagal mein ek hatash talmatol wale gota mein fenk deta hai.

panels.action: The demon's scythe arm shears cleanly through the thick industrial metal perimeter railing, throwing sparks into the pouring rain.
panels.prose_en: The demon's scythe arm shears cleanly through the thick industrial metal perimeter railing, throwing sparks into the pouring rain.
panels.prose_hi: Danav ki daraanti bhuja moti audyogik metal paridhi railing ke madhyam se safai se kaatati hai, jisse tez baarish mein chingari nikalti hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun skids on his knees through a deep puddle, gasping for air as he stares in horror at the severed steel posts.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Agar wo vaar mujhe lagta... toh meri gardan katt jaati!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun skids on his knees through a deep puddle, gasping for air as he stares in horror at the severed steel posts.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne ghutnon ke bal ek gahre pokhar mein fisalta hai, hanefata hai aur kate hue steel ke khambhon ko darawani drishti se dekhta hai.

panels.action: The Imp whips around with chilling unnatural speed, yellow eyes gleaming with sadistic mockery through the rain.

dialogue.speaker: imp_demon
dialogue.text: KEE-KEEK! EK BHEEGE CHUHE KI TARAH BHAAG RAHE HO?!

panels.prose_en: The Imp whips around with chilling unnatural speed, yellow eyes gleaming with sadistic mockery through the rain.
panels.prose_hi: Chhota sa bhoot thandi aprakritik gati se idhar-udhar ghumta hai, pili aankhen baarish ke madhyam se parpidk uphaas se chamakti han.

panels.action: The demon unhinges its jaw and spits a rapid volley of glowing green-black acidic venom globes toward Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_en: The demon unhinges its jaw and spits a rapid volley of glowing green-black acidic venom globes toward Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_hi: Danav apna jabda kholta hai aur Ha-Jun ki or chamakte hue hare-kale amleey jahar ke gole ki tej bauchhar karta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun instinctively throws his crystalline gauntlet up to shield his face; the venom globes splatter against the obsidian armor and hiss into harmless vapor.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun instinctively throws his crystalline gauntlet up to shield his face; the venom globes splatter against the obsidian armor and hiss into harmless vapor.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun sahaj roop se apne chehre ko dhalne ke liye apne crystaliy dastaane ko upar fenkata hai; jahar ke gole obsidian kavach par chhitakate hain aur hanirahit vashp mein badal jaate han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's body suddenly convulses with unbearable internal heat; the Sovereign's ancient bloodline rejects human weakness.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's body suddenly convulses with unbearable internal heat; the Sovereign's ancient bloodline rejects human weakness.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ka shareer achanak asahniya aantarik garmi se ainthane lagta hai; samprabhu ki prachin vanshavali manviya kamjori ko aswikar karti hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun clutches his collar, coughing violently as glowing violet mana mist leaks between his trembling fingers.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: K-Khoon mein... ubaal aa raha hai...!!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun clutches his collar, coughing violently as glowing violet mana mist leaks between his trembling fingers.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne collar ko pakad leta hai aur jor-jor se khansne lagta hai kyonki uski kampati ungaliyon ke beech chamakti baingani maina dhundh leak ho rahi hai.

panels.action: Abstract vision: Ancient Demon Sovereign genetic strands forcibly overwriting human DNA, super-charging muscles and bones with dark mana.

dialogue.text: Insaan ki hadd par... shaitan ka janam ho raha tha.

panels.prose_en: Abstract vision: Ancient Demon Sovereign genetic strands forcibly overwriting human DNA, super-charging muscles and bones with dark mana.
panels.prose_hi: Sar drishti: prachin danav samprabhu aanuvanshik kismen manav dna ko jabran adhilekhit karti han, gahre man ke saath manspeshiyon aur haddiyon ko super-charj karti han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's head arches back as he unleashes a primal scream; an eruption of neon-violet magical fire engulfs his silhouette.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's head arches back as he unleashes a primal scream; an eruption of neon-violet magical fire engulfs his silhouette.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ka sir peeche ki or jhuk jata hai aur wah ek prarambhik cheekh nikalta hai; niyan-bangni jaadui aag ka visfot uske chhayachitra ko gher leta hai.

panels.action: Extreme macro: Ha-Jun's eyes flare with brilliant violet rings and sharp vertical black slit pupils, radiating chilling divine pressure.

dialogue.text: Sovereign ki aankhein khul chuki theen.

panels.prose_en: Extreme macro: Ha-Jun's eyes flare with brilliant violet rings and sharp vertical black slit pupils, radiating chilling divine pressure.
panels.prose_hi: Charam sthul: Ha-Jun ki aankhen chamakdar baingani chhallon aur tej udhrvadhar kali slit putliyon se chamakti han, jo daiviy dabav ko wikirn karti han.

panels.action: The towering Lesser Imp stumbles backward in sheer horror, wings shivering as ancient ancestral hierarchy crushes its spirit.

dialogue.speaker: imp_demon
dialogue.text: Y-Yeh astitva...?! Yeh sirf ek insaan nahi ho sakta...!

panels.prose_en: The towering Lesser Imp stumbles backward in sheer horror, wings shivering as ancient ancestral hierarchy crushes its spirit.
panels.prose_hi: Uncha lesar imp atyant bhay ke karan peeche ki or ladkhadata hai, uske pankh kampane lagte hain kyonki prachin patrik padanukram uski aatma ko kuchal deta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun slowly straightens his spine; all trembling and pain have vanished, replaced by cold, regal, terrifying calm.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slowly straightens his spine; all trembling and pain have vanished, replaced by cold, regal, terrifying calm.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun dhire-dhire apni reedh sidhi karta hai; sari kanpkanpi aur dard gayab ho gaye han, unki jagah thandi, rajsi, bhayanak shanti ne le lee hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun exhales a plume of pure white mana steam into the freezing rain; his expression is ice-cold and merciless.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun exhales a plume of pure white mana steam into the freezing rain; his expression is ice-cold and merciless.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun thandi baarish mein shuddh safed man bhaap ka ek gubar chhodta hai; uski abhivyakti barf jaisi thandi aur nirdayi hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun disappears from sight in a sonic flash-step, leaving behind a circular shockwave crater in the wet concrete floor.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun disappears from sight in a sonic flash-step, leaving behind a circular shockwave crater in the wet concrete floor.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ek dhwani flash-step mein drishti se gayab ho jata hai, aur apne peeche gile concrete ke farsh mein ek golakar shockwev crator chhod jata hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun manifests instantaneously 12 feet in the air directly above the Lesser Imp, his right gauntlet cocked back like an anvil.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun manifests instantaneously 12 feet in the air directly above the Lesser Imp, his right gauntlet cocked back like an anvil.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun sidhe lesar imp ke theek upar hawa mein 12 feet upar prakat hota hai, uska dahina kavach nihaai ki tarah peeche ki or jhuka hua hota hai.

panels.action: The Imp frantically crosses both scythe arms upward to block, its yellow eyes wide in desperate panic.
panels.prose_en: The Imp frantically crosses both scythe arms upward to block, its yellow eyes wide in desperate panic.
panels.prose_hi: Chhota sa bhoot rokne ke liye bechain hokar donon daraanti bhujaon ko upar ki or ghumata hai, uski pili aankhen hatash ghabrahat mein chaudi ho jaati han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's crystalline purple gauntlet smashes down through the demon's scythe guard into its skull with blinding violet lightning.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's crystalline purple gauntlet smashes down through the demon's scythe guard into its skull with blinding violet lightning.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ka crystaliy baingani gauntlet, andhi baingani bijli ke saath danav ke skith guard ke madhyam se uski khopdi mein dhans jata hai.

panels.action: Massive wide shot: The shockwave obliterates thousands of raindrops in a gigantic radial dome; roof tiles shatter into dust.
panels.prose_en: Massive wide shot: The shockwave obliterates thousands of raindrops in a gigantic radial dome; roof tiles shatter into dust.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal wide shot: shockwev ek vishal radial gumbad mein hajaron baarish ki boondon ko nasht kar deti hai; chhat ki tilein dhul mein bikhar jaati han.

panels.action: The Lesser Imp is smashed flat into a massive circular crater in the concrete floor, dark demon blood spraying onto the puddles.
panels.prose_en: The Lesser Imp is smashed flat into a massive circular crater in the concrete floor, dark demon blood spraying onto the puddles.
panels.prose_hi: Lacer imp ko concrete ke farsh mein ek vishal golakar gaddhe mein tod diya gaya hai, pokharon par gahre danav khoon ka chhidkav ho raha hai.

panels.action: Standing over the demon, Ha-Jun clenches his fist; three radiant violet mana spikes erupt from his knuckles, piercing the demon's heart.
panels.prose_en: Standing over the demon, Ha-Jun clenches his fist; three radiant violet mana spikes erupt from his knuckles, piercing the demon's heart.
panels.prose_hi: Danav ke upar khade hokar, Ha-Jun ne apni mutthi band kar li; uske por se teen chamakdar baingani maina spikes futate han, jo rakshas ke dil ko chhedate han.

panels.action: The demon howls one final screech as its monstrous form disintegrates into glowing purple ash and black smoke.
panels.prose_en: The demon howls one final screech as its monstrous form disintegrates into glowing purple ash and black smoke.
panels.prose_hi: Danav ek aakhiri cheekh nikalta hai kyonki uska shaitani demonic roop chamakti baingani raakh aur kale dhuen mein bikhar jata hai.

panels.action: Where the demon's body lay, only a polished diamond-shaped violet demonic core crystal remains, hovering above the rain puddle.
panels.prose_en: Where the demon's body lay, only a polished diamond-shaped violet demonic core crystal remains, hovering above the rain puddle.
panels.prose_hi: Jahan rakshas ka shareer pada tha, vahan keval ek polish heere ke aakaar ka baingani shaitani demonic core crystal bacha hai, jo baarish ke pokhar ke upar mandra raha hai.

panels.action: The crystalline gauntlet generates a magnetic suction vortex, absorbing the core crystal into the back of Ha-Jun's hand.
panels.prose_en: The crystalline gauntlet generates a magnetic suction vortex, absorbing the core crystal into the back of Ha-Jun's hand.
panels.prose_hi: Cristliy gauntlet ek chumbkiya suction bhanwar utpann karta hai, jo Ha-Jun ke haath ke peeche core crystal ko avshoshit karta hai.

panels.action: System UI flashes: [TARGET ELIMINATED: LESSER IMP] | [MANA ABSORBED: BLOODLINE SYNCHRONIZATION 2.5%].
panels.prose_en: System UI flashes: [TARGET ELIMINATED: LESSER IMP] | [MANA ABSORBED: BLOODLINE SYNCHRONIZATION 2.5%].
panels.prose_hi: Sistm ui flash: [lakshya samapt: kam chhota sa hissa] | [man avshoshit: raktarekha tulyakalan 2.5%].

panels.action: The crystalline armor plates click and dissolve back into Ha-Jun's skin, leaving his normal pale hand without a single scratch.
panels.prose_en: The crystalline armor plates click and dissolve back into Ha-Jun's skin, leaving his normal pale hand without a single scratch.
panels.prose_hi: Cristliy kavach pleten click karti hain aur Ha-Jun ki tvacha mein wapas ghul jaati han, jisse uska samanya peela haath ek bhi kharonch ke bina rah jata hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun slumps back against the concrete parapet, gasping for breath as human fatigue crashes back into his frail body.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Maine... maine ek monster ko maar daala...?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slumps back against the concrete parapet, gasping for breath as human fatigue crashes back into his frail body.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun concrete ke parapet par wapas gir jata hai aur hanfne lagta hai kyonki manav thakan uske kamjor shareer mein wapas aa jaati hai.

panels.action: A swirling wisp of purple ember hovers near Ha-Jun's ear. An ancient, aristocratic, sardonic voice echoes directly in his mind.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: KAMAAL KA KHEL THA, MERE BACHE. AB WAQT HAI SACH JAAN NE KA.

panels.prose_en: A swirling wisp of purple ember hovers near Ha-Jun's ear. An ancient, aristocratic, sardonic voice echoes directly in his mind.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ke kaan ke paas baingani angaare ka ghumta hua tukda mandra raha hai. ek prachin, kulin, vyangyapurna awaz sidhe uske dimag mein goonjati hai.
